book.name: MATEUS
book.title: MATEUS Mateus nu pasa mayenu Yesus Kristus tuku kuyarna

content: Pagumba nye suŋgo tuku yaba pasa
Yesus nu maŋ yaba pasa ande saniŋmba sakina:
Kuate nu nuŋe gageu wike likate wam ta gabat suŋgo ande nuŋe kiŋo pino tam tuku pagumba nye suŋgo pilna taŋaŋ.
Ait kumuŋgina le nu nuŋe piro taŋgo kukulniŋgina le kumba ka buk saniŋgina mbal ta kilam kinaig. Nane kumba nane saniŋginaig kande nane ŋakmba mbule sulunaig.

Kile gabat suŋgo nu piro taŋgo afu saniŋgina: Tane kumba ka mbal buk saniŋgen ta teŋenmba saniŋgap. Nu makau ande pailnu fatnu afu kuya ŋak turmba bale farmba nyamagaŋ kilmba pagumba kile tane tairŋga minit. Nuŋe kiŋo pino tam tuku pagumba nye ta mbol prowap ŋga saniŋgap ŋgina le
nane kumba ka saniŋginaig kande nane ismba ake pasa sakanu sukmba ande nu tiŋga nuŋe piro mbol kina le ande nu tiŋga nuŋe ndametiŋ piro kam kina le
nane afu tiŋga nu tuku piro mbal ta kilmba ŋaigo siglika bale farnaig.
Taŋanaig le gabat suŋgo nu wam ta ismba nu gubra tumba nuŋe kame mbal kukulniŋgina le nane kumba ka nane bale far sulumba nane tuku tumbraŋ piynaig le ugna.
Kile nu nuŋe piro mbal afu saniŋgina: Pino tam tuku pagumba nye buk kuanekit ta saniŋgen mbal ta nane nda prowaig.
Tane kumba ka tumbraŋ suŋgo tuku ndin ŋakmba dubike lika taŋgo ŋakmba kaŋgerka pagumba nye te mbol prowam tuku saniŋgap ŋgina.
Taŋakina le nane kinaig ka ndin ŋakmba dubike lika mbal magenu ŋaigonu turmba kile-siglika ŋakmba kilmba pronaig le pino tam tuku pagumba nye ta tuku wande kumuŋgina.
Gabat suŋgo nu pronaig mbal ta kaŋgerkam wandek sinam kumba ande nu pagumba nye tuku kumiŋ tiŋge ndaka ake kumiŋ tiŋgina ta kaŋgerna sulumba
taŋgo ta sana: Mata, ne ndaŋam ake te prowat. Ne pagumba nye tuku kumiŋ tiŋgam kuga ŋga kusnana le nu kikonu maninok minna.

Kile gabat suŋgo ta nuŋe piro mbal saniŋgina: Taŋgo te kupe wai ndaleka bukŋgap le mayok ka ma make suŋgo sinam kuwa. Ma ta mbolŋge minamŋgaig mbal nane malmbi suŋgomba maketiŋ tikŋga minamŋgaig ŋgina.
Kuate nu nane gudommba nuŋe gageu minam tuku wikate ta nane ndui ndui ndo nu tuku gageu minam tuku madiniŋgit ŋga saniŋgina.
Takis pankam tuku pasa
Farisi mbal nane kumba ka naŋgine naŋgine saka ismba nu ame pasa mbarwa le biye tibe ŋga ndin sotinaig.

Taŋamba nane naŋgine dubinaig mbal afu Herodus dubinaig mbal afu ndoŋ kukulniŋginaig le Yesus tugum promba sanaig: Tum Taŋgo, ne taŋgo tugusek ta sine kila. Ne ande tuku kiko ndanate. Ne taŋgo nyu ŋak tuku kuru kuru ndakate. Taŋgo ŋakmba Kuate tuku maŋau dubikam tuku tumsiŋgit.
Ne sine sasiŋga. Sine Zu mbal siŋgine tukul maŋau dubimba Rom gabat Sesar takis tambim kumuŋ e? Ne ndaŋmba iduste ŋginaig.
Nane Yesus yabri paknaig ta nu katesemba nane saniŋgina: Tane yabri taŋgo ndo. Ndaŋam ye tagoyade?
Takis ndametiŋ ande tumba pro ye tumyap ŋgina le nane ndametiŋ ande tumba pro nu tunaig.
Taŋanaig le nu ndek nane kusnaniŋgina: Ndametiŋ te mbolŋge ima tuku kanu. Ima tuku nyu minit ŋga saniŋgina le

nane ndek sakinaig: Sesar tuku ŋginaig le Yesus nu nane teŋenmba saniŋgina: Ata. Tane gabat suŋgo Sesar kumnemŋge minig. Nu tambim tuku agaŋ sakate ta nu tape. Kuate nu agaŋ tambim tuku sakate ta Kuate tape ŋgina.
Taŋakina le nane pasa ta ismba pirerek purka nu kusremba luka kinaig.
Kummba maŋ aboŋgam tuku pasa
Ki ndui ta mbolŋge Sadusi taŋgo afu Yesus tugum pronaig. Sadusi mbal nane taŋgo kummba maŋ tiŋge nda ŋga idusmba minig tuku. Nane Yesus kusnanaig:
Tum Taŋgo, Moses nu teŋenmba kuyarna: Taŋgo ande kummba pino kuembol kiŋo kugatok kusrewa le maib nuŋeŋge pino ta tumba aba nuŋe tuku kiŋo te-pilwa ŋga kuyarna.
Ariya. Ma te mbolŋge taŋgo ande maib kat nuŋe 7 minnaig. Aba naŋgine pino ande tina sulumba minna ma ma kiŋo kugatok kumna le mambo nuŋe dubiknu nu pino ta tina.
Nu tumba minmba ma ma nu mata kiŋo kugatok kumna le mambo nuŋe keŋnu nu mata taŋana. Taŋamba taŋamba nane 7 ta pino ndui ta ndo tumba ka ka kiŋo kugatok kume farnaig le
ŋgumneŋga pino kuembol nu mata kumna.
Ata. Ne kumanu mbal tiŋgamŋgaig ŋga sakate ta taŋgo 7 ŋgamukŋge nu ima tuku pino minamŋgat? Nane ŋakmba pino ndui ta ndo tinaig ŋga Yesus sanaig.
Taŋakinaig le nu nane saniŋgina: Tane Kuate tuku kuyar pasa nu tuku saŋgri tane wamdus pulu ndatiŋgit. Ta tuku tane wamdus mbarde.
Nane kumanu mbal aboŋga tiŋga Kuate tuku eŋel suk minamŋgaig. Nane muŋgu kile nda.
Tane kumanu mbal tiŋge nda ŋga idusmba sakade ta pasa ande sine ŋakmba isam tuku Kuate nu sakina ta tane bur ndakade e? Pasa ta teŋenmba sakate.

Ye Abraham Isak Yakob nane tuku Mbara Suŋgo minet ŋga sakate. Abraham nane kume likinaig ta nduiye ŋgisikinaig kande Kuate ye nane tuku Mbara ŋga Moses sa ndana kande. Nu abo ŋak minig mbal tuku Mbara ŋga saniŋgina.
Taŋakina le maŋgur suŋgo Yesus tuku tum pasa ta isnaig sulumba piriri ŋayonaig.
Tukul pasa saŋgrinu
Yesus nu Sadusi mbal tuku pasa te-ibeŋna le nane pasa kugatok minnaig ta Farisi mbal nane wam ta ismba nane ŋakmba pro Yesus tugumŋge maŋgurkinaig.
Taŋamba nane tuku ande nu kusem pasa bitekŋga sakanu taŋgo Yesus tagowam tuku kusnana:
Tum Taŋgo, tukul ndaŋ tukul ŋakmba liniŋmba mbolŋge minit ŋga kusnana le
nu lafumba sana: Taŋgine Suŋgo Kuate tane nu tuku kume purmba taŋgine ŋgamuŋgal abo guwa wamdus ŋakmba nu tape.
Tukul pasa ta tukul ŋakmba liniŋgit.
Tukul ande taŋaŋ nu dubiknu teŋenmba. Tane taŋgine ŋgarosu tuku kume purde taŋamba ndo tane tugumŋge minig mbal tuku kume purap.
Tukul armba ta tukul pasa afu tuan taŋgo kame tuku pasa ta ŋakmba tuku tugu minik ŋga sana.
Yesus nu Kristus tuku nane kusnaniŋgina
Farisi mbal nane taŋge maŋgurka minnaig le Yesus nu nane kusnaniŋgina:
Kuateŋge madina taŋgo Kristus nu ima tuku mbuŋ ŋga idusde ŋga kusnaniŋgina le nane sakinaig: Nu David tuku mbuŋ ŋginaig.
Taŋakinaig le nu nane saniŋgina: Ta son ndeta Tukul Guwa nu ndaŋam David wamdus tuna le nu Kristus tuku saka nu ye tuku Suŋgo ŋga teŋenmba kuyarna.

content.text: Suŋgo Kuate nu ye tuku Suŋgo sana:
Ne ye tuku ndinam kumam teŋge saŋgri ŋak minyok mina le ma ma yeŋge ne tuku ŋgueu mbal ŋakmba kile-ibeŋka ne tuku kupe kumnemŋge patikamŋgit ŋgina. Mune 110.1

content: David nu taŋamba kuyarmba nu ye tuku Suŋgo ŋgina. Ata. Nu David tuku mbuŋ ndo e ko nu David tuku Suŋgo ŋgina.
Nu taŋamba kusnaniŋgina ta ŋakmba nu tuku pasa lafuwam fugumba maninok minnaig. Taŋamba nane ki ait ta mbolŋge ŋgumneŋga mata nu kuru-kuruka wam ande kusna ndanaig.
